subject.title: refactor(qa): migrate Matrix scenarios into QA Lab

question: Should this migration preserve the generic QA SDK and existing Gateway admission semantics, or intentionally adopt the Matrix-specific SDK calls and process-lifetime channel restart behavior?
rationale: The patch crosses both a shared Plugin SDK compatibility boundary and a production Gateway lifecycle boundary; tests alone cannot determine whether those permanent contracts match maintainer intent.

options.title: Restore both owner boundaries
options.body: Keep Matrix calls in QA Lab or its compatibility plugin and split or remove the global Gateway admission change until separately proved.

options.title: Approve the expanded contracts
options.body: Explicitly accept the Matrix-specific shared SDK surface and admission escape, then require full compatibility and concurrent lifecycle proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Restore both owner boundaries
recommendation.body: Keep Matrix calls in QA Lab or its compatibility plugin and split or remove the global Gateway admission change until separately proved.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the active stacked migration, authored the exact-head implementation, and can coordinate the QA and Gateway boundary decision with adjacent owners.
